title: Parmesan Baskets
description: This recipe for Parmesan baskets uses freshly shredded Parmesan cheese dropped onto a baking sheet, baked until golden, then formed into baskets shapes.
ingredients: 8 ounces freshly grated Parmesan cheese, divided

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Place a silicone mat onto a baking sheet or line with parchment paper.

Place about 2 teaspoons Parmesan cheese onto the prepared baking sheet; gently spread cheese into a circle about 2 inches in diameter. Place and spread more cheese circles onto the baking sheet, spaced at least 1 inch apart.

Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 4 to 5 minutes. Watch carefully to avoid burning. Remove from the oven. Cool on the baking sheet until warm, while still warm, drape cheese wafers over a small bowl or other container to form a basket shape. Cool. Store at room temperature in an airtight container.

video.description: Step up your tapas game with these clever crisp and cheesy baskets. All you need is Parmesan cheese and a parchment paper-lined baking sheet. Make circles of a couple teaspoons of shredded Parmesan and bake until golden. When you pull them from the oven, they’ll be pliable, so you can drape them over the back of a mini muffin tin, shot glasses or other small containers. As they cool they’ll become crispy and easy-to-serve snack containers for you to fill with mini salads or other appetizers! .
